## Table index

- [`article_media`](#article-media) — Revision-scoped placement, accessibility text, caption, credit, and order for media assets.
- [`article_revisions`](#article-revisions) — Immutable snapshots of all reader-visible article content and deterministic metadata.
- [`article_tags`](#article-tags) — Many-to-many relationship between stable articles and discovery tags.
- [`articles`](#articles) — Stable article identities and lifecycle pointers. Reader-visible content always comes from published_revision_id.
- [`audit_logs`](#audit-logs) — Append-only security and editorial mutation trail. Large article bodies are excluded from snapshots.
- [`authors`](#authors) — Public byline identities. auth_user_id is nullable until the single founder identity is linked.
- [`categories`](#categories) — Second-level controlled taxonomy. Every category belongs to exactly one pillar.
- [`citations`](#citations) — Ordered links from an immutable revision to normalized sources, with public locator/quotation data.
- [`featured_collection_items`](#featured-collection-items) — Ordered many-to-many placement of articles inside featured collections.
- [`featured_collections`](#featured-collections) — Founder-curated, optionally time-bounded editorial groupings used by the homepage and collection pages.
- [`media_assets`](#media-assets) — Private master asset metadata, provenance, rights, focal point, and processing state.
- [`media_variants`](#media-variants) — Pre-generated immutable delivery variants. Public variants map to media-public Storage objects.
- [`pillars`](#pillars) — Top-level editorial pillars such as History, Business, Psychology, and Society.
- [`publication_events`](#publication-events) — Append-only step log for a publication job, including verification and retry diagnostics.
- [`publication_jobs`](#publication-jobs) — Durable idempotent publication queue. Jobs target one immutable revision except unpublish actions.
- [`redirects`](#redirects) — Permanent internal path redirects. Automatic slug/pillar changes and founder-created redirects share one registry.
- [`search_projection`](#search-projection) — Published-only denormalized search read model rebuilt from an article published revision and taxonomy.
- [`site_settings`](#site-settings) — Typed-by-convention global publication configuration. Only rows marked public can be read anonymously.
- [`slug_history`](#slug-history) — Immutable canonical path history linked one-to-one with the redirect created for that prior path.
- [`source_notes`](#source-notes) — Private founder research notes. This table is never readable by anonymous users.
- [`sources`](#sources) — Normalized bibliographic and web source records reusable across article revisions.
- [`tags`](#tags) — Cross-pillar discovery terms. Tags do not control canonical URLs.

- **`media_assets_public_select`** — SELECT for anon, authenticated; USING: `((processing_status = 'ready'::media_processing_status) AND (rights_status <> ALL (ARRAY['unknown'::media_rights_status, 'restricted'::media_rights_status])) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1    FROM (article_media am      JOIN articles a ON ((a.published_revision_id = am.revision_id)))   WHERE ((am.media_asset_id = media_assets.id) AND (a.status = ANY (ARRAY['published_pending_verification'::article_status, 'published'::article_status]))))))`; CHECK: `—`.

| `title` | `text` | No | — | sources_title_length, sources_title_not_null | — |
| `author_text` | `text` | Yes | — |  | — |
| `publisher` | `text` | Yes | — |  | — |
| `publication_date` | `date` | Yes | — |  | — |
| `url` | `text` | Yes | — | sources_url_format | — |
| `archive_url` | `text` | Yes | — | sources_archive_url_format | — |
| `isbn` | `text` | Yes | — |  | — |
| `doi` | `text` | Yes | — | sources_doi_length | — |
| `accessed_at` | `date` | Yes | — |  | — |
| `created_by` | `uuid` | Yes | — |  | — |
| `created_at` | `timestamp with time zone` | No | now() | sources_created_at_not_null | — |
| `updated_at` | `timestamp with time zone` | No | now() | sources_updated_at_not_null | — |
| `source_fingerprint` | `text` | No | GENERATED: private.sha256_text(((((((lower(title) \|\| ' '::text) \|\| lower(COALESCE(author_text, ''::text))) \|\| ' '::text) \|\| lower(COALESCE(url, ''::text))) \|\| ' '::text) \|\| lower(COALESCE(doi, ''::text)))) | sources_source_fingerprint_not_null, sources_fingerprint_unique | Generated deduplication fingerprint; not a security credential. |

### Relationships

No outgoing foreign keys.

### Constraints

- **`sources_archive_url_format`** — `CHECK (archive_url IS NULL OR archive_url ~ '^https?://'::text)`
- **`sources_doi_length`** — `CHECK (doi IS NULL OR char_length(doi) <= 200)`
- **`sources_title_length`** — `CHECK (char_length(title) >= 1 AND char_length(title) <= 500)`
- **`sources_url_format`** — `CHECK (url IS NULL OR url ~ '^https?://'::text)`
- **`sources_created_at_not_null`** — `NOT NULL created_at`
- **`sources_id_not_null`** — `NOT NULL id`
- **`sources_source_fingerprint_not_null`** — `NOT NULL source_fingerprint`
- **`sources_source_type_not_null`** — `NOT NULL source_type`
- **`sources_title_not_null`** — `NOT NULL title`
- **`sources_updated_at_not_null`** — `NOT NULL updated_at`
- **`sources_pkey`** — `PRIMARY KEY (id)`
- **`sources_fingerprint_unique`** — `UNIQUE (source_fingerprint)`

### Index strategy

- **`sources_fingerprint_unique`** — `CREATE UNIQUE INDEX sources_fingerprint_unique ON public.sources USING btree (source_fingerprint)`
- **`sources_pkey`** — `CREATE UNIQUE INDEX sources_pkey ON public.sources USING btree (id)`

### RLS policy summary

- **`sources_admin_all`** — ALL for authenticated; USING: `( SELECT private.is_admin() AS is_admin)`; CHECK: `( SELECT private.is_admin() AS is_admin)`.
- **`sources_public_select`** — SELECT for anon, authenticated; USING: `(EXISTS ( SELECT 1    FROM (citations c      JOIN articles a ON ((a.published_revision_id = c.revision_id)))   WHERE ((c.source_id = sources.id) AND c.is_public AND (a.status = ANY (ARRAY['published_pending_verification'::article_status, 'published'::article_status])))))`; CHECK: `—`.

### Triggers

- **`sources_audit`** — `CREATE TRIGGER sources_audit AFTER INSERT OR DELETE OR UPDATE ON sources FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION private.audit_mutation()`
- **`sources_set_updated_at`** — `CREATE TRIGGER sources_set_updated_at BEFORE UPDATE ON sources FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION private.set_updated_at()`
## `tags`

Cross-pillar discovery terms. Tags do not control canonical URLs.

| `description` | `text` | Yes | — |  | — |

### Index strategy

- **`tags_active_name_idx`** — `CREATE INDEX tags_active_name_idx ON public.tags USING btree (name) WHERE is_active`

# Safe public views

## `public_redirects`

Safe public read model.

Columns: `from_path`, `to_path`, `http_status`.

## `public_site_settings`

Safe public read model.

Columns: `key`, `value`, `updated_at`.

## `published_articles`

Safe published article read model; excludes drafts, internal fields, and body_plain_text.

Columns: `id`, `canonical_slug`, `canonical_path`, `first_published_at`, `last_published_at`, `revision_id`, `title`, `dek`, `body_markdown`, `word_count`, `reading_time_minutes`, `seo_title`, `seo_description`, `social_title`, `social_description`, `content_checksum`, `author_id`, `author_name`, `author_slug`, `pillar_id`, `pillar_name`, `pillar_slug`, `category_id`, `category_name`, `category_slug`, `tags`.

## `published_citations`

Public citation snapshots and safe source metadata for currently published revisions.

Columns: `id`, `article_id`, `revision_id`, `ordinal`, `citation_key`, `citation_text`, `locator`, `public_note`, `quoted_text`, `source_id`, `source_type`, `source_title`, `author_text`, `publisher`, `publication_date`, `url`, `archive_url`, `isbn`, `doi`, `accessed_at`.

## `published_featured_collections`

Safe public read model.

Columns: `id`, `name`, `slug`, `description`, `position`, `label`, `article_id`, `canonical_path`, `title`, `dek`, `pillar_name`, `category_name`, `first_published_at`.

## `published_media`

Public derivative metadata only; private original object keys and rights notes are never selected.

Columns: `article_media_id`, `article_id`, `revision_id`, `role`, `position`, `alt_text`, `caption`, `credit_text`, `media_asset_id`, `kind`, `original_width`, `original_height`, `focal_x`, `focal_y`, `variant_id`, `variant_name`, `storage_key`, `mime_type`, `format`, `width`, `height`, `byte_size`, `checksum_sha256`.

# Enums

- **`article_status`** — `draft`, `scheduled`, `publishing`, `published_pending_verification`, `published`, `unpublished`, `archived`
- **`collection_status`** — `draft`, `published`, `archived`
- **`media_kind`** — `image`, `audio`, `video`, `document`
- **`media_processing_status`** — `pending`, `processing`, `ready`, `failed`
- **`media_rights_status`** — `unknown`, `owned`, `licensed`, `public_domain`, `creative_commons`, `permission_granted`, `restricted`
- **`media_role`** — `hero`, `inline`, `gallery`, `social`
- **`publication_action`** — `publish`, `republish`, `rollback`, `unpublish`, `schedule`
- **`publication_event_level`** — `info`, `warning`, `error`
- **`publication_job_status`** — `queued`, `processing`, `committed`, `verifying`, `succeeded`, `failed`, `dead_letter`, `cancelled`
- **`redirect_kind`** — `slug_change`, `pillar_change`, `manual`, `unpublish`
- **`revision_kind`** — `draft`, `publication`, `correction`, `rollback`, `import`
- **`source_type`** — `book`, `journal_article`, `news_article`, `website`, `report`, `archive`, `interview`, `dataset`, `video`, `other`

# Supabase Storage policy summary

- `media-originals` is private. Only the future authenticated admin claim can insert/read; referenced originals cannot be deleted through the founder client.
- `media-public` is public-read. Only the future authenticated admin claim can insert; referenced derivatives cannot be deleted through the founder client.
- Bucket definitions and all `storage.objects` policies are migration-managed in `20260808000800_storage_buckets_and_policies.sql`.
